title: Live MockLab mailbox gate (nine destination checks)
description:
Enable live MockLab so Jack can run the nine destination checks on app.withlanyard.com/mocklab without a fake local gateway. Jack tests. You do not write a QA suite.

## Cross-repo
Requires lac-r9w send, 1:1 hidden wake, halt, fuse-trip, room-tail, schedule-default. You cannot bd dep them. Do not close this leaf if those are still open. Name them in the close reason.

## Locked product rules that apply
- UAT gate: live MockLab tenant.
- Live talk needs a real gateway/relay. lp-jnrj still blocks image roll. This is the ONLY mailbox leaf blocked on lp-jnrj.
- Do not call talk done on a fake gateway.

## Nine checks (Jack clicks; you make them possible)
1. Speak in a channel; lead replies.
2. Lead (or Jack) @ another agent; that agent replies in the chosen room.
3. From a 1:1, bare @Fizz continues in Fizz's 1:1. Only Fizz's reply there. Bill's 1:1 text-only notice.
4. From a 1:1, @Fizz plus a room continues in that channel. Bill's 1:1 gets nothing. Channel shows Bill's bubble.
5. Walk away; they continue until Halt or the hidden fuse.
6. An agent can message another with no user message that day, if they share a channel.
7. A scheduled job can write Jack's 1:1 with that sender.
8. An agent in a 1:1 or channel can create a schedule or workflow (no create chrome). Jack can still open, edit, pause, delete it.
9. @ in composer offers agents, then provisioned connectors. File @ gone. Plus attaches a file or vault item.

## Files / areas
- Do not recreate lp-jnrj. That bug: relay Dockerfile workspace COPY omits packages/connectors while packages/bff depends on @lanyard/connectors. BFF Dockerfile already copies connectors. Fix lives on lp-jnrj.
- After lp-jnrj: image pin / MockLab redeploy (pattern lp-8sh4.7 / lp-jzfc). Entitlements if picker needs connectors.
- A short runbook on the bead close notes listing the nine checks. No Playwright catalog.

## Worker collision
Ops/deploy docs and pins. Do not reopen protocol PRs.

What NOT to do:
- Do not build a mailbox inbox, receipts UI, or tappable hop cards.
- Do not add a durable outbox table.
- Do not reopen or parent under lac-xsb, lac-bx3, lac-37a, lp-cxhb, lp-8sh4.
